reviewed_by: Codex review of the 3.0.20 bundled-Chromium and checkout-cleanup smoke failures
reason: The 3.0.20 Ubuntu job collected one case but Playwright requested an unbundled headless shell; checkout also removed the downloaded DEB before receipt writing. Select the workflow contract and receipt-binding tests plus the one core browser case. PR CI exercises the browser journey against source Core; the next release preparation must prove the installed DEB, bundled full Chromium, and embedded production UI.
exclusions: No application feature or native code changed. No frontend unit tests, unrelated Playwright entries, optional release diagnostics, or full suite are selected. The release-only Chromium channel and artifact path receive their definitive integration check in the next installed-DEB Ubuntu release job.
